---
title: "GIS Ad Hoc Analyses"
---

A working index of small, one-off GIS analyses for WFRC. Each analysis
lives in its own folder under `projects/`, with its own data sources,
script/notebook, and outputs. See `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` at the repo
root for conventions, and `projects/_template/` as the starting point for a
new analysis.

## Analyses

- [_template](projects/_template/index.qmd) -- example page proving the
  ArcGIS REST -> geopandas -> Quarto pipeline. Copy this folder to start a
  real analysis.
